{{Top|leg}}
'''Jukas Alim''' was a deep-voiced [[Musician/Legends|singer]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was one of the more popular singers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
